capabilities.name: Buyer security questionnaire answers
capabilities.summary: When a buyer sends a security questionnaire, your sales owner gets a draft answer matrix: each question beside the evidence your security owner supplied, its date, its limits and a named reviewer, with stale, partial and unverifiable answers marked.

capabilities.name: Cloud spend variance bridge
capabilities.summary: When cloud or tooling costs move away from budget, the finance lead and the engineering manager get a bridge from budget to actual by service and cost owner, with usage beside each large move, the unallocated and shared costs, and the questions each side must answer.

capabilities.name: Implementation blocker brief
capabilities.summary: When a customer's setup milestone slips, the implementation lead gets one brief: the missing inputs, the unresolved access and data questions and the dependencies behind the delay, each with its source and an owner, plus points to raise with the customer.

capabilities.name: Subscription billing exception sheet
capabilities.summary: Before a subscription billing run, or when a customer disputes a charge, the billing specialist gets a sheet tying each account's plan, quantity and invoice lines to the approved price mapping and the seat or usage records, with doubtful matches kept open.

capabilities.name: Technical demo plan
capabilities.summary: Before a technical discovery or demo meeting, the account executive and solutions engineer get an attendee brief, a demo sequence built around the buyer's stated workflow from approved scenarios, and open questions. Requests nobody has verified stay questions.

capabilities.name: Usability test session plan
capabilities.summary: Before a prototype or a confusing flow goes in front of users, the research lead and product owner hold one plan: who to recruit, the tasks in plain words, the neutral prompts, a blank note sheet and how success is counted. Recording and data handling are listed as decisions.
